verdict.rationale: Apify supports scheduling Actors/tasks to run autonomously (apify-docs-6), monitoring and alerting on runs (apify-docs-7), API/CLI control (apify-docs-3, probe-2/4), and native MCP server integration letting AI agents discover and trigger Actors and workflows mid-run (apify-docs-10, apify-docs-16, probe-3), directly supporting autonomous background automation for AI-native users.
